title: Water management and conservation element objectives
text: O4.16.1 Minimise potable water consumption throughout the development. O4.16.2 Stormwater runoff from small rainfall events is managed on-site, wherever practical. O4.16.3 Reduce the risk of flooding so that the likely impacts of major rainfall events will be minimal.
notes: Register C4P2-129: Vol2 Appendix A6 (summary list of all element objectives) is deleted with no draft equivalent, so these O records are the only listing of the 4.x objectives.
